notes: mw-e39.20: Captain Hesketh of the Gilded Tern (bible 5.14). Crew hiring is an emit hook (hesketh.crew-signed); the shanghai scene is entered by the entry shanghai when the contest system sets hesketh.shanghaied (bible 4.5: losing the Drowned Gull contest) and resolves to a day's work or a successful argument, both emit hesketh.shanghai-scene. Tereza's debt of honour opens the gangway (hesketh.board-requested). The veiled passenger in the locked berth is never revealed (MVP).

nodes.speaker: hesketh
nodes.text: Hesketh, master of the Gilded Tern. Knight, is it? I can use a marine's discipline on deck. A tidy sword is good for tidy cargo. Do you have a berth in mind, or a grudge?

nodes.speaker: hesketh
nodes.text: Hesketh, Gilded Tern. You have the look of someone who spots things far off. I could use that in the crow's nest. Pirates, rocks, the harbourmaster. All equally unwelcome.

nodes.speaker: hesketh
nodes.text: Captain Hesketh. A sorcerer, I see. Mind the rigging, and mind the rum. Can you charm a wind? The harbour is flat as a plate and I am three days late for it.

nodes.speaker: hesketh
nodes.text: Captain Hesketh, and this is my ship, and every crate aboard is already accounted for. I have a good memory for cargo. I should hate to test it on you. Welcome aboard, nearly.

nodes.speaker: hesketh
nodes.text: Hesketh, Captain, Gilded Tern. We load slowly, we sail when the cargo is aboard, and we do not discuss the cargo. Is it work or passage you are after?

nodes.speaker: hesketh
nodes.text: Back on the quay. Good. The Tern waits for no one, except when she does. Out with it.

nodes.speaker: hesketh
nodes.text: Awake, are you? You lost the contest at the Drowned Gull, and a shilling bought your name on my articles. It is all legal. I never say anything that is not. Welcome to the Gilded Tern's hold.

options.text: Fine. What do I work off?
That contract is a farce, Captain.

nodes.speaker: hesketh
nodes.text: Scrub the deck, stow the crates, and not a word about what is under the tarpaulins. A day's labour, and you are back on the quay with a sore back and a story.

nodes.speaker: hesketh
nodes.text: Hm. The articles say 'willing hand'. You do not look willing. Fair. Over the side, then, politely, by the gangway. And do not tell Nell the drink was watered.

nodes.speaker: hesketh
nodes.text: A farce, is it? Signed in your own ink. Well: work it off, and I will say it was a great honour. The deck is that way.

options.text: Tell me about the Gilded Tern.
Who is in the locked berth?
Tereza said I might come aboard.
I could give you a Gust.
Perhaps a quiet corner of the hold.

nodes.speaker: hesketh
nodes.text: Fair winds, and mind the gangway; it has opinions.

nodes.speaker: hesketh
nodes.text: Three masts, forty tons of ironwork and a hold built for silver. She goes where the cargo goes, and when it is ready. Old, but quicker than she looks. Rather like me.

nodes.speaker: hesketh
nodes.text: When the last crate is stowed, and the tide, the wind and the harbourmaster agree. Not before. Do not look at the hoist; it is slow, and it is dignified.

nodes.speaker: hesketh
nodes.text: A passenger. Paid in advance, and paid well. Keeps the berth locked and the lamp low, and I take their coin and do not ask. A captain who asks loses his cargo.

nodes.speaker: hesketh
nodes.text: Hiring? Hands, yes, when the weather is fair and my crew is drunk. It is hard work, simple coin, and no questions about the cargo. Are you willing?

nodes.speaker: hesketh
nodes.text: Done. Report at dawn, bring your own boots. Keep the crew ranks clean and your questions few. The Tern will remember you, and so will I.

nodes.speaker: hesketh
nodes.text: Tereza sent you? Then you are no stranger. The debt of honour is a bore, and you are its price. Aboard, and be quick. The gangway is open.

nodes.speaker: hesketh
nodes.text: A marine. I have not had one since the Isles. Mind the passengers' doors, keep the deck clear, and do not fight the crew. Good pay; steady work; long watch.

nodes.speaker: hesketh
nodes.text: Good. Climb when the light is bad and shout when you see anything that is not sea. And do not shoot the gulls; they are the crew's friends.

nodes.speaker: hesketh
nodes.text: Can you? A steady north-west, from the harbour mouth. My sails would weep for joy. I cannot pay, but the crew will remember it; they have long memories and short tempers.

nodes.speaker: hesketh
nodes.text: Quiet corner of my hold. No, thank you. I have forty tons of other people's cargo down there and a very good memory. I should hate for you to improve my inventory.
